description: This is a Python source file defining classes and functions for image and video object detection within the ImageAI library. It includes classes for handling image reading modes, object detection with support for YOLOv3, TinyYOLOv3, and RetinaNet models, as well as a class for video detection. The file manages model loading, inference, and detection result processing, and references multiple external libraries and internal modules.

classes.name: ImageReadMode
classes.description: Enumeration for different modes of reading images, including unchanged, grayscale, grayscale with alpha, RGB, and RGB with alpha.

classes.name: ObjectDetection
classes.description: Class providing image object detection support supporting YOLOv3, TinyYOLOv3, and RetinaNet models, including model loading, inference, and detection result processing.

classes.name: VideoObjectDetection
classes.description: Class for performing object detection on videos or live streams, supporting model setup, inference, and callback functions for processing frames.

methods.name: __load_classes
methods.description: Loads class labels from a specified file.

methods.name: __load_image_yolo
methods.description: Loads and preprocesses an image for YOLO models, returning filenames, original images, dimensions, and processed tensors.

methods.name: __save_temp_img
methods.description: Saves a numpy array or PIL image to a temporary JPEG file and returns its path.

methods.name: __load_image_retinanet
methods.description: Loads and preprocesses an image for RetinaNet models, returning filenames, original images, and scaled tensors.

methods.name: setModelTypeAsYOLOv3
methods.description: Sets the model type to YOLOv3.

methods.name: setModelTypeAsTinyYOLOv3
methods.description: Sets the model type to TinyYOLOv3.

methods.name: setModelTypeAsRetinaNet
methods.description: Sets the model type to RetinaNet.

methods.name: setModelPath
methods.description: Sets the file path to the pretrained model weights.

methods.name: useCPU
methods.description: Forces the model to run inference on CPU.

methods.name: loadModel
methods.description: Loads the model weights into the model architecture based on the set model type and path.

methods.name: CustomObjects
methods.description: Defines custom object detection classes to filter detection results.

methods.name: detectObjectsFromImage
methods.description: Performs object detection on an input image, returning detection results and optionally saving or returning images with detections.
